title: Systematic identification of genomic markers of drug sensitivity in cancer cells
central_claims: Large cancer-cell drug screens link genomic features with drug sensitivity and supply a biomarker discovery platform.
EWS-FLI1-positive Ewing sarcoma cells are selectively sensitive to PARP inhibitors.

source_manifest.title: Replication Study: Systematic identification of genomic markers of drug sensitivity in cancer cells
source_manifest.finding: Ewing versus osteosarcoma sensitivity difference was nonsignificant; engineered rearrangement and knockdown tests did not retain original differential sensitivity.

source_manifest.title: Unearthing new genomic markers of drug response by improved measurement of discriminative power
source_manifest.finding: Independent GDSC reanalysis found new markers and validated them in later data; filtering discarded spurious associations.

source_manifest.title: Phase II study of olaparib in patients with refractory Ewing sarcoma following failure of standard chemotherapy
source_manifest.finding: No objective responses among 12 participants; monotherapy trial stopped accrual. Some authors overlap with original, so not independent confirmation.
